entities.summary: Nikola Dobrović was a Serbian architect, teacher, and urban planner. Dobrović designed a number of buildings including the Yugoslav Ministry of Defence building, later destroyed during the Kosovar War by NATO bombings, the New Belgrade planned city or various buildings in Prague and around Dubrovnik.
